grain_rationale: dataset.row_count is 166158 with duplicate_row_rate 0.0, meaning every row is already a distinct flight instance with no exact-duplicate rows to collapse; no single column is unique on its own (flight_number distinct_count 2994 is far below row_count), so grain_type is transaction with a derived identity over flight_date, carrier_code, flight_number, origin_airport, and dest_airport that together uniquely identify each flight leg.

fields.name: flight_date
fields.description: Calendar date of the scheduled flight, ranging from 2013-01-01 to 2013-06-30 across 181 distinct dates with no nulls.

fields.name: carrier_code
fields.description: Two-letter carrier code (16 distinct values such as 9E, AA, DL, UA) identifying the operating airline, present on every row.

fields.name: flight_number
fields.description: Operator-assigned flight number ranging 1 to 8500 across 2994 distinct values; it labels a flight rather than measuring anything.

fields.name: origin_airport
fields.description: Origin airport code limited to EWR, JFK, LGA (3 distinct values), present on every row.

fields.name: sched_dep_hhmm
fields.description: Scheduled departure time encoded as HHMM (500-2359, 969 distinct values), a time label rather than a measure.

fields.name: dest_airport
fields.description: Destination airport code with 100 distinct values such as ABQ, ACK, ALB, present on every row.

fields.name: tail_number
fields.description: Aircraft tail number (3825 distinct values, e.g. D942DN, N0EGMQ), nullable in about 0.9% of rows likely when the operating aircraft was not recorded.

fields.name: is_cancelled
fields.description: Flag indicating whether the flight was cancelled (true/false), present on every row.

fields.name: dep_hhmm
fields.description: Actual departure time encoded as HHMM (1-2400), nullable in about 2.9% of rows, consistent with flights that never actually departed.

fields.name: dep_delay_minutes
fields.description: Departure delay in minutes ranging -33 to 1301 across 469 distinct values, nullable in about 2.9% of rows matching missing actual departure times; summed or averaged across flights.

fields.name: arr_hhmm
fields.description: Actual arrival time encoded as HHMM (1-2400), nullable in about 3.07% of rows, a time label rather than a measure.

fields.name: sched_arr_hhmm
fields.description: Scheduled arrival time encoded as HHMM (1-2359), present on every row.

fields.name: arr_delay_minutes
fields.description: Arrival delay in minutes ranging -86 to 1272 across 526 distinct values, nullable in about 3.3% of rows matching missing actual arrival data; summed or averaged across flights.

fields.name: air_time_minutes
fields.description: Flight duration in minutes ranging 20 to 695, nullable in about 3.3% of rows matching missing arrival/departure timing data; a duration measure.

fields.name: distance_miles
fields.description: Great-circle distance flown in miles ranging 80 to 4983 across 203 distinct values, present on every row; a measure summed or averaged across flights.

fields.name: sched_dep_hour_local
fields.description: Local scheduled departure hour (5-23, 19 distinct values), a time label rather than a measure.

fields.name: sched_dep_minute_local
fields.description: Local scheduled departure minute (0-59, 60 distinct values), a time label rather than a measure.

fields.name: departure_hour_utc
fields.description: Scheduled departure instant in UTC at hour granularity (samples run 2013-01-01T10:00:00 through 2013-07-01T03:00:00 across 3439 distinct values, each on the hour), the event timestamp for this fact.

fields.name: carrier_name
fields.description: Full carrier name (16 distinct values such as Delta Air Lines Inc., United Air Lines Inc.) corresponding to carrier_code, present on every row.

fields.name: aircraft_manufacturer
fields.description: Aircraft manufacturer (34 distinct values such as AIRBUS, BOEING), nullable in about 16% of rows likely when the tail number did not resolve to a registry entry.

fields.name: aircraft_model
fields.description: Aircraft model (121 distinct values such as 172E, 310Q), nullable in about 16% of rows matching the same missing registry lookups as aircraft_manufacturer.

fields.name: aircraft_manufacture_year
fields.description: Year the aircraft was manufactured (1956-2013, 46 distinct values), nullable in about 17.7% of rows; a label year rather than a measure.

fields.name: aircraft_seat_count
fields.description: Number of seats on the aircraft (2-450, 47 distinct values), nullable in about 16% of rows matching missing aircraft registry data; a quantity that can be summed or averaged.

fields.name: aircraft_engine_type
fields.description: Aircraft engine type (6 distinct values such as Turbo-fan, Turbo-jet), nullable in about 16% of rows matching missing aircraft registry data.

fields.name: origin_airport_name
fields.description: Full origin airport name (3 distinct values: John F. Kennedy International Airport, LaGuardia Airport, Newark Liberty International Airport), present on every row.

fields.name: origin_municipality
fields.description: Origin municipality (New York or Newark, 2 distinct values), present on every row.

fields.name: origin_elevation_ft
fields.description: Origin airport elevation in feet (13, 18, or 21 ft; 3 distinct values), a reference attribute of the airport rather than a flight measure.

fields.name: origin_longest_runway_ft
fields.description: Origin airport's longest runway length in feet (7002-14511, 3 distinct values), a reference attribute of the airport.

fields.name: dest_airport_name
fields.description: Full destination airport name (99 distinct values), nullable in about 2.1% of rows likely for destinations not matched to the airport reference.

fields.name: dest_municipality
fields.description: Destination municipality (95 distinct values), nullable in about 2.1% of rows matching missing destination airport reference data.

fields.name: dest_iso_region
fields.description: Destination ISO region code (45 distinct values such as US-AL, US-CA), nullable in about 2.1% of rows matching the same missing destination reference data.

fields.name: dest_elevation_ft
fields.description: Destination airport elevation in feet (3-6606, 90 distinct values), nullable in about 2.1% of rows matching missing destination reference data; a reference attribute.

fields.name: dest_longest_runway_ft
fields.description: Destination airport's longest runway length in feet (5076-16000, 84 distinct values), nullable in about 2.1% of rows; a reference attribute.

fields.name: captured_at
fields.description: Ingestion capture timestamp recorded at profiling time (16 distinct values spanning 2026-09-02T23:25:51 to 2026-09-02T23:26:06), not the business event time and retained only as a load-time reference.

category_description: Each row represents one scheduled commercial flight leg departing from a New York-area airport (EWR, JFK, or LGA) during 2013, carrying its scheduling, operational timing, delay, aircraft, and origin/destination airport reference attributes.
purpose: This mapping declares how the silver.silver_flights table enters the gold unified event star as the flights fact category, naming the event timestamp, grain, and field roles that the deterministic modeling engine consumes to generate the gold fact and its dimensions.
usage: The rendered draft is validated against the frozen mapping-contract schema, checked by a validator and datacontract lint, and reviewed and edited by a human before approval; only after approval does the modeling engine consume it to generate gold models.
limitations: This mapping does not filter cancelled flights (is_cancelled) or rows with missing actual departure/arrival timing (dep_hhmm, arr_hhmm, dep_delay_minutes, arr_delay_minutes, air_time_minutes each roughly 3% null), and it does not resolve aircraft registry gaps (aircraft_* columns around 16-17.7% null) or destination reference gaps (dest_* columns around 2.1% null); handling of those conditions is left to downstream consumers.
